integrity: The proof reconstructs the maximal false-twin classes from the nondegenerate alternating commutator form on \(G/Z(G)\), proves necessity and sufficiency of the per-class \(s-1\) condition separately for resolving and determining sets, and then factors the complete set enumerator. The packaged checker independently builds projective symplectic models and small actual Heisenberg groups and exhausts the six-vertex boundary case.
scientific_limitations: The group is assumed extraspecial of order \(p^{1+2n}\).
The result does not cover arbitrary special or generalized extraspecial groups.
The resolving polynomial counts unordered vertex subsets by cardinality.
title: Resolving and determining sets in extraspecial noncommuting graphs
